text: How does our system talk to Uzcard and Humo, when they speak different languages?
prefix: How does our system talk to Uzcard and Humo, when they speak different languages?

text: Uzcard speaks JSON-RPC, and Humo speaks SOAP, with different fields and different errors.
prefix: Uzcard speaks JSON-RPC, and Humo speaks SOAP, with different fields and different errors.

text: If the payment code knew both, every new scheme would mean touching payment code, and no other project could reuse the work.
prefix: If the payment code knew both, every new scheme would mean touching payment code, and no other project could reuse the work.

text: So each scheme gets its own adapter: a separate Spring Boot service with its own OpenAPI contract, that any service or project may call.
prefix: So each scheme gets its own adapter: a separate Spring Boot service with its own OpenAPI contract, that any service or project may call.

text: Every adapter answers plain REST: an envelope with a request id, the scheme's status and the data, or a problem detail that carries the scheme's own code.
prefix: Every adapter answers plain REST: an envelope with a request id, the scheme's status and the data, or a problem detail that carries the scheme's own code.

text: Inside, every scheme method is one command, picked by its type from a factory, the same way in both adapters.
prefix: Inside, every scheme method is one command, picked by its type from a factory, the same way in both adapters.

text: A status file in each adapter turns every scheme code into a status, and the card module turns the scheme's decline codes into our own.
prefix: A status file in each adapter turns every scheme code into a status, and the card module turns the scheme's decline codes into our own.

text: Uzcard debits in one step, by the card's token, with our payment id as the external reference; if that reference was sent before, Uzcard answers pending instead of paying twice, and a lookup by that reference settles it.
prefix: Uzcard debits in one step, by the card's token, with our payment id as the external reference; if that reference was sent before, Uzcard answers pending instead of paying twice, and a lookup by that reference settles it.

text: Humo holds the money first, and the card module captures the hold right away; a capture that gets no answer is taken on the next lookup.
prefix: Humo holds the money first, and the card module captures the hold right away; a capture that gets no answer is taken on the next lookup.

text: The card module needs only the published client library and one port, a card processor, with one processor per scheme.
prefix: The card module needs only the published client library and one port, a card processor, with one processor per scheme.

text: Every answer becomes one of three outcomes: approved, declined with our own code, or unknown.
prefix: Every answer becomes one of three outcomes: approved, declined with our own code, or unknown.

text: A timeout answers five oh two, and the card module reads it as unknown, never a decline, because the money may already have moved.
